summary: B28 (Notification Orchestration) + B29 (Compliance/Permit Guidance) validated end-to-end. Backend: 34/34 pytest pass (100%). Frontend web smoke: hi-inbox bell (9+ badge), notification-settings marketing-consent switch, safety in_app switch disabled per spec, compliance page for hazard project renders 'Professional review recommended', 'Consider a professional' escalation card (comp-pro), electrical+structural work-category chips, 7 checklist items (comp-check-*), comp-package/comp-verified/comp-location all present. Admin nav emits distinct admin-nav-notiforch and admin-nav-compliance keys (separate from pre-existing admin-nav-notifications broadcast). One real backend bug was found and FIXED by the testing agent: `if _db.<collection>` truthy checks on motor Collections raise NotImplementedError; the exception was swallowed by generic try/except in compliance_engine.create_package → returned 502 Bad Gateway. Same anti-pattern existed in notification_engine._validate_access. Both replaced with try/except blocks. After fix all endpoints work.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: motor AsyncIOMotorCollection objects raise NotImplementedError on bool()/truthy checks. Original patterns `await _db.hi_project_materials.find(...).to_list(100) if _db.hi_project_materials else []` (compliance_engine.py:306) and `await _db.prop_members.find_one(...) if _db.prop_members else None` (notification_engine.py:359) would fail on every call. In compliance_engine this was caught by a broad `except Exception` → returned 502 to the client with no traceback logged — the /compliance/package endpoint was 100% broken before the fix. Replaced both with explicit try/except blocks.

notification_engine.notify() correctly enforces: safety-in_app always allowed, marketing requires opt-in consent (returns user_opt_out suppression), 24h dedupe by event_type+entity+channel, quiet-hours only for push/email non-safety, admin category pause + pause_nonessential.
Marketing/safety/billing templates correctly gate on requires_approval; draft→active with approval required returns 409, and only allowed after status transitions through approved.

compliance_engine._classify correctly bumps to professional_review_recommended for load-bearing + electrical + panel keywords; verified with real hazard project (electrical+structural) and cosmetic project (general_guidance).
Compliance rules cannot go active without source_date (409); package always labeled PRELIMINARY and address excluded by default (address_included=false).
Non-admin (demo_home) correctly receives 403 on all /api/hi/admin/notifications/* and /api/hi/admin/compliance/* endpoints.
10+ seeded compliance rules (active) and 10+ seeded notification templates confirmed.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of /api/hi/compliance/package 502: Motor's AsyncIOMotorCollection intentionally raises NotImplementedError on bool()/truthy testing (must compare with `is not None`). Line 306 used `... if _db.hi_project_materials else []` which triggered the error on every request. The surrounding try/except caught it and raised HTTPException(502) with a generic message, hiding the traceback. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/hi/compliance/package -d '{project_id, included_entities:{}}'` → 502. Mitigation: replaced ternary with try/except around the .to_list() call, defaulting to []. Same fix applied to notification_engine.py line 359 (_db.prop_members truthy check in _validate_access) which would have failed similarly whenever a shared-access notification item was opened.
